spans.s:
(ए) चते r. 1st cl. (चतति-ते)
To ask, to beg, to solicit.

ind.
Four times: see चतुर्.

nf. (-लं-ला)
A square formed by four houses.
E.
चतुर् four, शाला a hall or house: the compound takes the neuter gender or the feminine, with टाप् affix; also with कन् added चतुःशालक.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 The number sixty-four.
2 The Rig

Veda.
3

Art or science collectively, supposed to comprise sixty-four branches.
E.
चतुर् four, and षष्टि sixty; before ष, र becomes Visarga.

mfn. plu. only, (चत्वारः चतस्र चत्वारि)
Four:
in composition, and the last member of a compound, the numeral is inflected in all the numbers; thus प्रियचतुर् Who has four favorites, makes masc. and fem. (sing.) प्रियचत्वा (du.) त्वारौ (plu.) त्वारः and n. (sing.) प्रियचतुः (du.) चत्वारी (plu.) चत्वारि, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Dexterous, ingenious, clever.
2 Visible, perceptible.
m. (-रः)
1 A round pillow, one for the cheek.
3 An elephant stable.
E.
चत to ask, Uṇādi affix उरच्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Perceptible, visible.
2 Speaking well or amiably.
3 Driving, one who drives, a driver, a charioteer, &c.
4 Clever, able, ingenious.
5 Relating to four.
f. (-री)
Dexterity, ability, cleverness.
m. (-रः)
A small round pillow for resting the cheek upon.
n. (-रं)
A carriage, a cart holding four people.
E.
चतुर dexterous, or चतुर् four, अण् affix; also with कन् added चातुरक.

n. (-ङ्गः)
1 An entire army, comprising elephants, cars, horse and foot.
2 A sort of chess.
E.
चतुर्, and अङ्ग a member.

n. (-लं)
An entire army: see the last.
E.
चतुरङ्ग, and बल an army.

n. (-न्यं)
An entire army: see चतुरङ्ग.
E.
चतुरङ्ग, and सैन्य an army.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
Having four parts or members.
f. (-ङ्गिनी)
An army.
E.
चतुरङ्ग, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Four fingers, (long, &c.)
m. (लः)
A kind of Cassia, (Cassia fistula.)
E.
चतुर् four, and अङ्गुली a finger; the leaves being four fingers in length.

mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं)
Four cornered, quadrangular.
n. (-स्रं)
A square.
E.
चतुर् four, and अस्र a corner.

m. (-नः)
A name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
चतुर् four, and आनन face; fourfaced.

m. (-तिः)
A tortoise.
E.
चतुर four (feet), and गति motion; a quadruped.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Four times, four-fold.
E.
चतुर्, and गुण multiplication.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था or -र्थी-र्थं)
Fourth.
f. (-र्थी)
The fourth lunation.
E.
चतुर् four, थुक् aff.

n. (-लं)
The fourth season, implying especially the evening of every second day of a person's fasting.
E.
चतुर्थ, and काल time.

n. (-लं)
(In Astronomy,) The second inequality or equation of a planet.
E.
चतुर्थ, and फल quotient.

m. (-शः)
A quarter, a fourth part.
E.
चतुर्थ, and अंश part.

f. (-का)
A Pala.
E.
कन् fem. form added to चतुर्थ.

mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्)
Four toothed.
E.
चतुर four, दतृ substituted for दन्त a tooth.

m. (-न्तः)
INDRA'S elephant.
E.
चतुर four, and दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Fourteen.
f. (-शी)
The fourteenth lunation.
E.
चतुर्दश, and टच् aff.

mfn. plur. (-दश)
Fourteen.
E.
चतुर, and दशन् ten.

n. (-लं)
A royal litter.
E.
चतुर four, (supporters,) दोल a swing.

ind.
Four times, four-fold.
E.
चतुर, and धा aff.

n. (-द्रं)
The aggregate of four objects of human wishes, viz. virtue, love, wealth, and final beatitude.
E.
चतुर four, and भद्र fortunate, auspicious: see चतुर्व्वर्ग.

m. (-गः)
Fourth part.
E.
चतुर्, and भाग a share.

m. (-जः)
1 A name of VIṢṆ

An equilateral tetragon.
E.
चतुर् four, and भुज an arm.

m. (-खः)
1 The deity

BRAHMĀ.
2

A preparation of mercury.
E.
चतुर्, and मुख a face.

n. (-गं)
The aggregate of the four Yugas or ages of the Hindus, a Mahāyuga or 4,320,000 years.
E.
चतुर् four, and युग an age.

m. (-क्त्रः)
A name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
चतुर् four, and वक्त्र a face: see चतुर्मुख and other synonymous compounds.

m. (-र्गः)
1 The four objects of human pursuit collectively: see चतुर्भद्र.
2 Any assemblage of four things.
E.
चतुर् four, and वर्ग class.

m. (-र्णः)
1 The four classes of

Hindus.
2

Four principal colours.
3 Four letters.
E.
चतुर्, and वर्ण tribe.

m. (-द्यः)
A priest who has studied the four Vedas.
E.
चतुर् four, विद्या knowledge; also चतुर्वेद, and with अण् added चातुर्वेद्य and चातुर्वैद.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Of four sorts or kinds, in four ways.
E.
चतुर्, and विध kind.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Depositing, placing, fixing.

f. (-ला)
A square of four houses, or a court inclosed by four buildings.
E.
चतुर्, and शाला a hall.

mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं)
Four.
f. (-ष्की)
1 A large four-sided pond or tank.
2 A bed or musquito curtain.
3 A necklace of four strings.
E.
चतुर् four, कन् affix, and र is changed to ष.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Square, quadrangular.
m. (-णः)
A square, a tetragon.
E.
चतुर्, and कोण a corner.

Four.
2

Four-fold.
n. (-यं)
1 A square.
2 The centre of a circle.
3 The aggregate of four.
E.
चतुर, and तयट् aff.

m. (-थः)
A Brahman.
n. (-थं)
A place where four roads meet.
E.
चतुर् four, and पथि a road, अ aff.

nf. (-दं-दी)
Verse, a metre of stanzas especially consisting of four Padas or lines.
m. (-दः)
An animal with four legs, a quadruped.
E.
चतुर् four, and पद for पाद a foot; also read चतुष्पाद.

f. (-टी)
A river.
E.
चतुर् four (the four quarters), and पाटी what goes.

f. (-ठी)
A school for Brahmans.
E.
चतुर् four, (the Vedas,) पाठ perusal.

m. (-णिः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
चतुर् four, and पाणि a hand; the four-handed.

mfn. (-पात्)
1 A quadruped.
2 A whole of four parts or quarters.
2 A judicial procedure, consisting of four processes, plea, defence, rejoinder, and sentence.
E.
चतुर्, and पाद् a foot.

n. (-मं)
An unguent of four ingredients, Sandal, agallochum, saffron, and musk.
E.
चतुर् four, and सम equal, same.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A Buddha, a Bauddha saint.
E.
चतुस्रिंशत् thirty-four, जातक species, and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-रं)
1 A levelled spot of ground prepared for a sacrifice.
2 A court yard.
E.
चत to ask, Uṇādi affix वरच्.

m. (-लः)
1 A hole in the ground, &c. prepared for oblation with fire.
2 The womb.
3 Kusa grass.
E.
चत to ask, वालच् affix, or with वालञ् affix, चात्वल.

m. (-लः)
1 A hollow made in the ground to receive a burnt offering.
3 Any hole in the ground.
E.
चत to ask, (to solicit the gods,) and वालञ् Uṇādi affix; also चत्वाल, q. v.

m. (-कः)
A bird, a kind of cuckoo, (Cuculus melano-leucus.)
E.
चत to beg, affix ण्वुल्; begging water from the clouds, the supposed sole source of the fluid which this bird drinks.

m. (-नः)
The rainy season.
E.
चातक, and आनन्दन delighting.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
See the preceding.

n. (-म्यं)
The aggregate of the four orders of student, householder, mendicant and ascetic.
E.
चतुर four, आश्रम order, ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A charioteer, a coachman.
E.
चातुर a carriage, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A quartan ague.
E.
चतुर्थ, अण् affix, and कन् added.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Produced in four months.
E.
चतुर्म्मास, and अण् aff.

n. (-स्यं)
A sacrifice performed every four months.
E.
चतुर, and मास a month, यञ् aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Dexterity, cleverness.
E.
चतुर, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-र्ण्यः-र्ण्या-र्ण्यं)
Suited to the four tribes, belonging to them, &c.
n. (-र्ण्यं)
The aggregate of the four original castes, the Brāhmaṇa, Kṣatriya, Vaiśya and Śūdra.
E.
चतुर four, and वर्ण a class, ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-ध्यं)
Four kinds collectively.
E.
चतुर्विध, and ञ aff.

m. (-द्यः)
A priest, &c. versed in the four Vedas.
E.
चतुर four, वेद a Veda, and ष्यञ् affix; it is also derived from विद्या knowledge, and is optionally as here given, or चातुर्विद्य.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Performed by four priests, read or sacrificed by, &c.
E.
चतुर, होतृ a priest, ठक् aff.
